searchText: MSRP $278,621. New 2026 Thor Motor Coach Outlaw Wild West Edition Toy Hauler model 38M is approximately 39 feet 10 inches in length with 2 slide-out rooms, high polished aluminum wheels, residential refrigerator, bug screens at rear in the garage, roller shades on the driver & passenger windows, as well as drop down ramp door with spring assist & railing for patio use. This RV features the optional solar charging system and full body paint. This beautiful new motorhome also features the new Ford chassis with 7.3L PFI V-8, a 6-speed TorqShift® automatic transmission, an updated instrument cluster, automatic headlights and a tilt/telescoping steering wheel. The Outlaw Wild West toy hauler RV has an incredible list of standard features including beautiful wood & interior decor packages, LED TVs, (2) A/C units, power patio awing with integrated LED lighting, dual side entrance doors, 1-piece windshield, a 5500 Onan generator, 3 camera monitoring system, automatic leveling system, Soft Touch leather furniture and day/night shades.
